## What this adds or changes

<!-- A new skill? A fix to an existing one? A doc change? One paragraph. -->

## If this is a new skill

- [ ] The failure it prevents, in one sentence: 
- [ ] Three real instances of that failure: 
- [ ] The description uses the user's symptoms, not module names (60–600 characters)
- [ ] `## When to use`, ground rules, procedure, anti-patterns, definition of done, report format
- [ ] Lookup material is in `references/` and every reference is linked
- [ ] Boundary written: when **not** to use it, and which skill to use instead

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes (validator + links)
- [ ] `npm run catalog` run and the diff checked in
- [ ] Tested with and without the skill on a real task — the comparison is below

```text
Task:
Without:
With:
```

## Anything unverified

<!-- A skill that implies more than it can deliver is worse than no skill. Say what it does not cover. -->
